Got it. Zoloft is sertraline, so that's the albuterol inhaler and your sertraline, right?
Perfect. I'll request the albuterol and the sertraline from Brightway now.

turns.caller: Actually leave the inhaler at Brightway, I've still got one.

args.reason: Sertraline transfer from Brightway 4471 to H-302 failed: transfer system down. Please submit it when it is back. Albuterol stays at Brightway.

agent.text: No problem, just the sertraline then. I tried to request it from Brightway twice, but our transfer system is down right now, so nothing has been requested yet. I've asked our pharmacist to put the request through as soon as the system is back, and they'll give you a call.
